en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Quran is a Covenant of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> to His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures. Thus, it is befitting for the Muslim person that he looks into his covenant, and that he recites from it, during every day, fifty Verses’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Holy Quran is a covenant of Allah with His creatures. A Muslim must look at his covenant and read fifty verses every day.”
